glosses: culture; cultural (of or relating to culture)

examples.en: What do you mean by cultural relativism?

examples.text: Londres era muy importante por razones económicas y culturales.
examples.en: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.

examples.text: Es más, sigo pensando que esto no es una diferencia cultural enorme.
examples.en: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.

examples.text: Como ciudadano del mundo, conozco maneras de superar las barreras culturales.
examples.en: As a citizen of the world, I know ways of overcoming cultural barriers.
